name: Wall of Flesh
text:
**Wall of Flesh** (Teamwork)

You swarm with your allies, becoming a wall of creatures.

**Prerequisites**: Small size or smaller.

**Benefit**: When adjacent to an ally with this feat, you’re
 considered one size category larger for determining CMD
 and the way combat maneuvers and abilities affect you.
